name: University of Tennessee at Chattanooga
tuition_note: In-state tuition & fees FY 2025-26 from UTC Bursar In-State Fee Schedule PDF (utc.edu/document/156542): full-time undergraduate resident (12+ hours) total = $5,381/semester (maintenance $4,356 + mandatory fees), x2 = $10,762/year. Housing (room only) from UTC Residence Halls/Meal Plans/Parking Fee Schedule PDF (utc.edu/document/156547): standard residence hall rate $3,932/semester x2 = $7,864/year; room-only rates range $3,196-$5,284/semester depending on hall/room type. Meal plans billed separately.
